samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative/generative math construction task — the requester invites the model to invent an elegant setup. Petrel reports a positive generativity slope (preferring open-ended invention), and both models tie on relevant capability evals, so routing to the model that prefers this flavor of task is sensible.

This is an open-ended creative/generative math task ("you pick," "your call on the setup," "make it elegant") with friendly, warm tone. Petrel reports a positive generativity slope for open-ended invention and benefits from warm framing; both models tie on capability for this.

This is an open-ended creative invention task (designing an elegant problem with free coefficient choice), matching Petrel's positive generativity preference and its strong Creative Generation profile. There's no harm-adjacent content that would favor Willet's specialization, and capability scores are otherwise effectively tied.
